insider_transactions.details: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform the exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company ("IL JIN") has completed the acquisition of the balance 40% equity stake of Power-One Micro Systems Private Limited ("Power-One") from Mr. Ramanna Rajesh Mayasandra, Mr. Harsha Venkatesh, Dwaith Advisory Private Limited and Mrs. Doddabidere Honappa Venna, shareholders of Power-One, pursuant to Share Swap agreement executed on 18th October 2026, thereby making Power-One a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of IL JIN and Wholly-Owned step down subsidiary of the Company. Further, 1,76,000 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares A3 have been allotted by IL JIN to Mr. Ramanna Rajesh Mayasandra, Mr. Harsha Venkatesh, Dwaith Advisory Private Limited and Mrs. Doddabidere Honappa Veena, as a non -cash consideration, for the aforesaid, in terms of the said Share Swap Agreement.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform the exchange that IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company ("IL JIN") has completed acquisition of the balance 1.50% equity stake of Ascent Circuits Private Limited ("Ascent Circuits"), from Ms. Manju Thomas, shareholder of Ascent Circuits, pursuant to Share Swap Agreement executed on 18th October 2026, thereby making Ascent Circuits Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of IL JIN and Wholly-Owned step down subsidiary of the Company. Further, 13,120 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares A2 have been allotted by IL JIN to Ms. Manju Thomas, as non-cash consideration, for the aforesaid acquisition, in terms of the said Share Swap Agreement.
